nodes.description: address public owner; owner of the contract, set to msg.sender in the Owned constructor.
address public newOwner; pending owner used by transferOwnership/acceptOwnership two-step handover.
string public symbol = "AVM".
string public name = "AVM Tokens".
uint8 public decimals = 18.
uint public _totalSupply; total token supply set in the AVMToken constructor.
mapping(address => uint) balances; token balance ledger written by transfer/transferFrom.
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) allowed; ERC20 allowance ledger.
SafeMath.safeAdd(uint a, uint b) returns c = a + b with require(c >= a).
SafeMath.safeSub(uint a, uint b) requires b <= a and returns c = a - b.
SafeMath.safeMul(uint a, uint b) returns a * b guarded by require(a == 0 || c / a == b).
SafeMath.safeDiv(uint a, uint b) requires b > 0 and returns a / b.
Owned() constructor: sets owner = msg.sender.
transferOwnership(address _newOwner) public onlyOwner: stores pending owner in newOwner.
acceptOwnership(): requires msg.sender == newOwner, then promotes newOwner to owner and clears newOwner.
AVMToken() constructor: initialises symbol/name/decimals/_totalSupply and credits the full supply to a fixed address.
totalSupply() constant returns _totalSupply - balances[address(0)].
balanceOf(address tokenOwner) constant returns balances[tokenOwner].
transfer(address to, uint tokens): debits msg.sender via safeSub and credits `to` via safeAdd.
approve(address spender, uint tokens): sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens.
transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens): debits `from`, decrements allowance of msg.sender and credits `to`.
allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender) constant returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
approveAndCall(address spender, uint tokens, bytes data): approves then calls receiveApproval on the arbitrary spender contract.
function () public payable { revert(); } — rejects all plain ETH transfers.
transferAnyERC20Token(address tokenAddress, uint tokens) onlyOwner: external call to arbitrary token contract's transfer(owner, tokens).
msg.sender — untrusted caller used for ownership, balance and allowance bookkeeping.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data) to an attacker-controlled address.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) to a caller-supplied contract address.
Unchecked addition c = a + b inside safeAdd, guarded only by require(c >= a).
Subtraction c = a - b inside safeSub, guarded only by require(b <= a).

Owned() constructor derives ownership directly from untrusted msg.sender.
owner state variable is written in the constructor.
onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner before transferOwnership runs.
newOwner state variable is assigned in transferOwnership.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before transferring ownership.
owner is promoted to newOwner in acceptOwnership.
newOwner is reset to address(0) in acceptOwnership.
Constructor initialises the symbol state variable.
Constructor initialises the name state variable.
Constructor initialises the decimals state variable.
Constructor sets _totalSupply.
Constructor credits the full supply into the balances mapping.
totalSupply reads _totalSupply.
totalSupply subtracts balances[address(0)].
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender]; the caller controls which balance is spent.
transfer updates balances of msg.sender and `to`.
transfer calls safeSub to debit the sender.
transfer calls safeAdd to credit the recipient.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender], so the caller owns the allowance slot.
approve writes the allowed mapping.
transferFrom spends allowed[from][msg.sender]; caller identity determines the allowance debited.
transferFrom updates balances[from] and balances[to].
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender].
transferFrom calls safeSub for both balance and allowance debits.
transferFrom calls safeAdd to credit the recipient.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
approveAndCall sets the allowance of msg.sender and passes msg.sender into the callback.
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] before the external call.
approveAndCall performs an external call to an attacker-supplied spender contract while state is already updated; the callee can re-enter the token.
The external receiveApproval callback can transferFrom the freshly granted allowance or re-enter approve/transfer before the caller finishes.
transferAnyERC20Token is restricted by onlyOwner against untrusted msg.sender.
transferAnyERC20Token makes an external call to a caller-supplied token contract address.
Malicious token contract can re-enter the token contract's functions during the external transfer call.
Swept tokens are sent to the owner state variable.
